name: hexagon-videomasking
title: Hexagon Video Mask Alt
blurb: Looping video clipped into a hexagon shape using CSS mask.
description: Plays a muted, auto-looping video masked by a hexagon SVG. Uses CSS mask-image pointing to a public /hexagon.svg file.
use_when: Hero or feature sections where a hexagonal frame adds a modern geometric touch.
avoid_when: Browsers without CSS mask support. The SVG mask file must be available at /hexagon.svg.
a11y: Video is muted and autoplays. Purely decorative. No controls or alternatives.
